title: Signed metadata document and endpoint
acceptance: GET /.well-known/amk-authority serves metadata with issuer, metadata_version, published_at, profile, root_kid, signing_keys, revocation_list_url and signature
Signed by the root key only; Cache-Control max-age does not exceed DV-ATA-08
Published through R2 with a KV mirror
Never publishes a duplicate kid, and every kid equals the thumbprint of its public_key
findings: Corrections: path is /.well-known/amk-authority (not /metadata); cache default is 300 s (not 3600 s); field names are revocation_list_url and revocation_status_url; the root key signs metadata only.
